title: Kiss of Death
note: Bill says during the Con Air ep that they'll do it in season 11 of the Rewatchables; Bill says he's a huge Kiss of Death guy during the King of New York ep; a Feb 2025 tweet from the pod's account asks for Kiss of Death to be added to Tubi or Prime Video https://x.com/TheRewatchables/status/1894426639322304854/; mentioned again in Bill rants during the Someone to Watch Over Me, The Sting and Ace Ventura eps
plot: Jimmy Kilmartin's an ex-con who's trying to go straight. But he can't say no to a quick driving job because his so-called friend's life is threatened. The job is for Little Junior Brown, a violent and powerful villain. When things go wrong, Jimmy is left to do the time, and his whole life is turned upside-down, but if that wasn't enough, the cops won't leave Jimmy alone when he gets out... They want Little Junior Brown.
